question_en: Which statements are true? 1) a magnetic field acts on a charge at rest; 2) the Lorentz force is always perpendicular to the particle's velocity; 3) the Lorentz force increases the kinetic energy of the particle; 4) in a uniform field the period of revolution does not depend on the particle's speed; 5) a particle entering along the lines moves in a circle.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) magnit maydon tinch zaryadga ta'sir qiladi; 2) Lorens kuchi doim tezlikka perpendikulyar; 3) Lorens kuchi zarra kinetik energiyasini oshiradi; 4) bir jinsli maydonda aylanish davri tezlikka bog'liq emas; 5) chiziqlar bo'ylab uchib kirgan zarra aylana chizadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) магнитное поле действует на покоящийся заряд; 2) сила Лоренца всегда перпендикулярна скорости частицы; 3) сила Лоренца увеличивает кинетическую энергию частицы; 4) в однородном поле период обращения не зависит от скорости частицы; 5) частица, влетевшая вдоль линий, движется по окружности.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Kuch tezlikka tik — ish yo'q, Eₖ o'zgarmaydi; T = 2πm/(|q|B) tezlikka bog'liq emas. Tinch zaryadga va chiziqlar bo'ylab harakatda F = 0.
Asos: Lorens kuchi xossalari.

uz: 1, 3, 5 — noto'g'ri; 2, 4 — to'g'ri: $$\vec F\perp\vec v\ \Rightarrow\ A=0;\qquad T=\frac{2\pi m}{|q|B}$$
ru: 1, 3, 5 — неверны; 2, 4 — верны: $$\vec F\perp\vec v\ \Rightarrow\ A=0;\qquad T=\frac{2\pi m}{|q|B}$$
en: 1, 3, 5 are false; 2, 4 are true: $$\vec F\perp\vec v\ \Rightarrow\ A=0;\qquad T=\frac{2\pi m}{|q|B}$$

rules.en: The Lorentz force does no work: $A=0$

distractors.A: eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri tasavvurlar tanlangan
distractors.D: chiziqlar bo'ylab harakatda ham aylana bo'ladi deb olingan
distractors.E: magnit maydon tinch zaryadga ham ta'sir qiladi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: пропущено утверждение 4 (период не зависит от скорости)
distractors_ru.D: принято, что и при движении вдоль линий будет окружность
distractors_ru.E: принято, что магнитное поле действует и на покоящийся заряд

distractors_en.A: the most common misconceptions were chosen
distractors_en.C: statement 4 (period independent of speed) was missed
distractors_en.D: it was assumed that motion along the lines also gives a circle
distractors_en.E: it was assumed that a magnetic field acts on a charge at rest too

question_en: An alpha particle ($q=3.2\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$) enters a field of induction $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$ with a speed of $3\cdot10^{6}\ \mathrm{m/s}$ at an angle of $30^\circ$ to the field lines. Find the Lorentz force acting on it ($10^{-13}\ \mathrm{N}$).
question_uz: Alfa-zarra ($q=3.2\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$) induksiyasi $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan maydonga $3\cdot10^{6}\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan induksiya chiziqlariga $30^\circ$ burchak ostida uchib kirdi. Unga ta'sir qiluvchi Lorens kuchini toping ($10^{-13}\ \mathrm{N}$).
question_ru: Альфа-частица ($q=3.2\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$) влетела в поле с индукцией $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$ со скоростью $3\cdot10^{6}\ \mathrm{m/s}$ под углом $30^\circ$ к линиям индукции. Найдите действующую на неё силу Лоренца ($10^{-13}\ \mathrm{N}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. F = qvB·sin30° = 3,2·10⁻¹⁹·3·10⁶·0,5·0,5 = 2,4·10⁻¹³ N.
Asos: Lorens kuchi formulasi.

en: $\alpha$ is the angle between the velocity and the induction: $$F=qvB\sin\alpha=3.2\cdot10^{-19}\cdot3\cdot10^{6}\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=2.4\cdot10^{-13}\ \mathrm{N}$$

distractors.E: kuch faqat tik harakatda bor deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: принято, что сила есть только при перпендикулярном движении

distractors_en.A: sinα was not taken into account (taken as perpendicular)
distractors_en.B: the cosine was used instead of the sine
distractors_en.D: the charge was taken as e (an alpha particle has 2e)
distractors_en.E: it was assumed that the force exists only for perpendicular motion

question_en: The speed of an electron was increased $3$ times and the induction of the magnetic field was decreased $6$ times. The angle between the velocity and the induction is constant. Find the ratio of the Lorentz forces $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
question_uz: Elektronning tezligi $3$ marta orttirildi, magnit maydon induksiyasi $6$ marta kamaytirildi. Tezlik va induksiya orasidagi burchak o'zgarmas. Lorens kuchlarining nisbati $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Скорость электрона увеличили в $3$ раза, индукцию магнитного поля уменьшили в $6$ раз. Угол между скоростью и индукцией постоянен. Найдите отношение сил Лоренца $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. F ∼ vB: F₂/F₁ = 3·(1/6) = 1/2.
Asos: F = |q|vB·sinα.

en: The force is proportional to the speed and the induction: $$\frac{F_2}{F_1}=\frac{v_2}{v_1}\cdot\frac{B_2}{B_1}=3\cdot\frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$$

distractors.D: tezlik kamaygan, induksiya kamaygan deb olingan
distractors.E: kuch tezlik kvadratiga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что уменьшились и скорость, и индукция

distractors_en.C: the induction was taken as increased too
distractors_en.D: both the speed and the induction were taken as decreased
distractors_en.E: the force was taken as proportional to the speed squared

question_en: The kinetic energy of a particle entering a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the field lines was increased $4$ times. How many times does the radius of the circle it describes increase?
question_uz: Bir jinsli magnit maydonga induksiya chiziqlariga tik uchib kiradigan zarraning kinetik energiyasi $4$ marta orttirildi. U chizadigan aylana radiusi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Кинетическую энергию частицы, влетающей в однородное магнитное поле перпендикулярно линиям индукции, увеличили в $4$ раза. Во сколько раз увеличится радиус описываемой ею окружности?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. R = √(2mEₖ)/(|q|B), ya'ni R ∼ √Eₖ: energiya 4 marta ortsa, radius 2 marta ortadi.
Asos: R = p/(|q|B).

en: The radius is proportional to momentum, momentum to $\sqrt{E_k}$: $$R=\frac{\sqrt{2mE_k}}{|q|B}\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{R_2}{R_1}=\sqrt{4}=2$$

distractors.C: radius energiya kvadratiga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: радиус спутан с периодом (период не меняется)

distractors_en.A: the radius was taken as proportional to the energy
distractors_en.B: the radius was taken as decreasing
distractors_en.C: the radius was taken as proportional to the energy squared
distractors_en.E: the radius was confused with the period (the period does not change)

question_en: An electron moves in a uniform magnetic field along a circle of radius $R$ with speed $v$, and a Lorentz force $F$ acts on it. Find the work done by the Lorentz force during half a revolution.
question_uz: Elektron bir jinsli magnit maydonda radiusi $R$ bo'lgan aylana bo'ylab $v$ tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda, unga $F$ Lorens kuchi ta'sir qiladi. Yarim aylanish davomida Lorens kuchi bajargan ishni toping.
question_ru: Электрон движется в однородном магнитном поле по окружности радиусом $R$ со скоростью $v$, на него действует сила Лоренца $F$. Найдите работу силы Лоренца за половину оборота.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Lorens kuchi har onda tezlikka tik: cos90° = 0, ish nolga teng, tezlik moduli o'zgarmaydi.
Asos: A = Fs·cosα.

uz: Kuch ko'chishga har onda tik: $$A=F\,s\cos90^\circ=0,\qquad \Delta E_k=0$$
ru: Сила в каждый момент перпендикулярна перемещению: $$A=F\,s\cos90^\circ=0,\qquad \Delta E_k=0$$
en: The force is perpendicular to the displacement at every instant: $$A=F\,s\cos90^\circ=0,\qquad \Delta E_k=0$$

rules.en: The Lorentz force does no work: $A=0$

distractors.A: kuch yo'l uzunligi πR ga ko'paytirilgan
distractors.D: ish kinetik energiyaning o'ziga teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: сила умножена на длину пути πR
distractors_ru.D: работа принята равной самой кинетической энергии

distractors_en.A: the force was multiplied by the path length πR
distractors_en.B: the force was multiplied by the diameter (displacement)
distractors_en.C: the momentum change 2mv was confused with work
distractors_en.D: the work was taken as equal to the kinetic energy itself

question_en: The figure shows a uniform magnetic field (the induction points into the drawing, $\otimes$) and an electron moving upward in it. Where does the Lorentz force on the electron point?
question_uz: Rasmda bir jinsli magnit maydon (induksiya chizmaga kiradi, $\otimes$) va unda yuqoriga harakatlanayotgan elektron ko'rsatilgan. Elektronga ta'sir qiluvchi Lorens kuchi qayerga yo'nalgan?
question_ru: На рисунке показано однородное магнитное поле (индукция направлена в рисунок, $\otimes$) и электрон, движущийся в нём вверх. Куда направлена сила Лоренца, действующая на электрон?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Elektron uchun chap qo'l barmoqlari tezlikka qarshi (pastga), B kaftga kiradi — bosh barmoq o'ngga.
Asos: F = qv × B, q < 0.

uz: $q=-e$, $\vec v=v\vec j$, $\vec B=-B\vec k$: $$\vec F=-evB\,\vec j\times(-\vec k)=evB\,\vec i\ \Rightarrow\ \rightarrow$$
ru: $q=-e$, $\vec v=v\vec j$, $\vec B=-B\vec k$: $$\vec F=-evB\,\vec j\times(-\vec k)=evB\,\vec i\ \Rightarrow\ \rightarrow$$
en: $q=-e$, $\vec v=v\vec j$, $\vec B=-B\vec k$: $$\vec F=-evB\,\vec j\times(-\vec k)=evB\,\vec i\ \Rightarrow\ \rightarrow$$

rules.uz: Chap qo'l qoidasi: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$
rules.ru: Правило левой руки: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$

distractors.C: kuch tezlik bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.E: magnit maydon elektronga ta'sir qilmaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: правило применено как для положительного заряда
distractors_ru.E: принято, что магнитное поле не действует на электрон

distractors_en.A: the rule was applied as for a positive charge
distractors_en.C: the force was taken along the velocity
distractors_en.D: the force was taken as braking the motion
distractors_en.E: it was assumed that the field does not act on the electron

question_en: The figure shows a uniform field between the poles of a magnet (the induction points to the right) and a proton moving out of the drawing towards us ($\odot$). Where does the Lorentz force on the proton point?
question_uz: Rasmda magnit qutblari orasidagi bir jinsli maydon (induksiya o'ngga yo'nalgan) va chizmadan bizga qarab ($\odot$) harakatlanayotgan proton ko'rsatilgan. Protonga ta'sir qiluvchi Lorens kuchi qayerga yo'nalgan?
question_ru: На рисунке показано однородное поле между полюсами магнита (индукция направлена вправо) и протон, движущийся из рисунка к нам ($\odot$). Куда направлена сила Лоренца, действующая на протон?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v = v·k, B = B·i: k × i = j — kuch yuqoriga. Chap qo'l: B kaftga, barmoqlar bizga qarab — bosh barmoq yuqoriga.
Asos: F = qv × B.

uz: $\vec v=v\vec k$, $\vec B=B\vec i$: $$\vec F=evB\,\vec k\times\vec i=evB\,\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \uparrow$$
ru: $\vec v=v\vec k$, $\vec B=B\vec i$: $$\vec F=evB\,\vec k\times\vec i=evB\,\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \uparrow$$
en: $\vec v=v\vec k$, $\vec B=B\vec i$: $$\vec F=evB\,\vec k\times\vec i=evB\,\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \uparrow$$

rules.uz: Chap qo'l qoidasi: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$
rules.ru: Правило левой руки: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$

distractors.B: kuch induksiyaga qarshi yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.D: kuch induksiya bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.E: tezlik tik bo'lsa ham kuch yo'q deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: принято, что силы нет, хотя скорость перпендикулярна

distractors_en.A: the sign was reversed (right hand used)
distractors_en.B: the force was taken opposite to the induction
distractors_en.D: the force was taken along the induction
distractors_en.E: it was assumed there is no force although the velocity is perpendicular

question_en: The velocity of an electron points along the $x$ axis. How must the magnetic induction be directed for the Lorentz force to point against the $y$ axis? The $z$ axis points towards the observer (right-handed coordinate system).
question_uz: Elektron tezligi $x$ o'qi bo'ylab yo'nalgan. Lorens kuchi $y$ o'qiga qarshi yo'nalishi uchun magnit maydon induksiyasi qanday yo'nalgan bo'lishi kerak? $z$ o'qi kuzatuvchiga qarab yo'nalgan (o'ng koordinatalar sistemasi).
question_ru: Скорость электрона направлена вдоль оси $x$. Как должна быть направлена индукция магнитного поля, чтобы сила Лоренца была направлена против оси $y$? Ось $z$ направлена к наблюдателю (правая система координат).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. F = −e(v × B) = −F·j ⇒ i × B ∼ +j ⇒ B ∼ −k, chunki i × (−k) = j.
Asos: F = qv × B.

uz: $q=-e$: $\vec v\times\vec B$ kuchga qarshi bo'lishi kerak: $$\vec i\times(-\vec k)=\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \vec F=-evB\,\vec j$$
ru: $q=-e$: $\vec v\times\vec B$ должно быть против силы: $$\vec i\times(-\vec k)=\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \vec F=-evB\,\vec j$$
en: $q=-e$: $\vec v\times\vec B$ must be opposite to the force: $$\vec i\times(-\vec k)=\vec j\ \Rightarrow\ \vec F=-evB\,\vec j$$

rules.uz: Chap qo'l qoidasi: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$
rules.ru: Правило левой руки: $\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B$

distractors.C: induksiya kuchga qarshi yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.D: induksiya kuch bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.E: induksiya tezlik bo'ylab — bunda kuch nolga teng

distractors_ru.B: правило применено как для положительного заряда
distractors_ru.E: индукция вдоль скорости — тогда сила равна нулю

distractors_en.B: the rule was applied as for a positive charge
distractors_en.C: the induction was taken opposite to the force
distractors_en.D: the induction was taken along the force
distractors_en.E: induction along the velocity — then the force is zero

question_en: An electron enters a uniform field of induction $4.55\ \mathrm{mT}$ perpendicular to the lines with a speed of $16\ \mathrm{Mm/s}$. Find the radius of curvature of the trajectory ($\mathrm{cm}$). $m_e=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_uz: Elektron induksiyasi $4.55\ \mathrm{mT}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonga chiziqlarga tik ravishda $16\ \mathrm{Mm/s}$ tezlik bilan uchib kirdi. Trayektoriyaning egrilik radiusini toping ($\mathrm{cm}$). $m_e=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_ru: Электрон влетел в однородное поле с индукцией $4.55\ \mathrm{mT}$ перпендикулярно линиям со скоростью $16\ \mathrm{Mm/s}$. Найдите радиус кривизны траектории ($\mathrm{cm}$). $m_e=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.

distractors_en.A: the diameter was found instead of the radius
distractors_en.C: the answer was left in metres

question_en: A proton and an alpha particle ($q_\alpha=2e$, $m_\alpha=4m_p$) rotate in the same uniform magnetic field. Find the ratio of the periods of revolution $\frac{T_\alpha}{T_p}$.
question_uz: Proton va alfa-zarra ($q_\alpha=2e$, $m_\alpha=4m_p$) bir xil bir jinsli magnit maydonda aylanmoqda. Aylanish davrlarining nisbati $\frac{T_\alpha}{T_p}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Протон и альфа-частица ($q_\alpha=2e$, $m_\alpha=4m_p$) вращаются в одном и том же однородном магнитном поле. Найдите отношение периодов обращения $\frac{T_\alpha}{T_p}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. T = 2πm/(|q|B) ∼ m/q: Tα/Tp = (4/2) = 2. Davr tezlikka bog'liq emas.
Asos: aylanish davri formulasi.

en: The period is inversely proportional to the specific charge: $$\frac{T_\alpha}{T_p}=\frac{m_\alpha}{m_p}\cdot\frac{e}{q_\alpha}=4\cdot\frac{1}{2}=2$$

distractors.C: davr hech narsaga bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что период ни от чего не зависит

distractors_en.B: only the mass ratio was used
distractors_en.C: the period was taken as independent of everything
distractors_en.D: a square root of the ratio was taken

question_en: A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field at an angle of $60^\circ$ to the field lines and moves along a helix. Find the ratio of the pitch of the helix to its radius $\frac{h}{R}$.
question_uz: Zaryadli zarra bir jinsli magnit maydonga induksiya chiziqlariga $60^\circ$ burchak ostida uchib kirib, vintsimon chiziq bo'ylab harakatlanmoqda. Vint qadamining vint radiusiga nisbati $\frac{h}{R}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Заряженная частица влетела в однородное магнитное поле под углом $60^\circ$ к линиям индукции и движется по винтовой линии. Найдите отношение шага винта к его радиусу $\frac{h}{R}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. h = v·cosα·T, R = v·sinα·T/(2π) ⇒ h/R = 2π·ctgα = 2π/√3.
Asos: vint qadami h = v∥·T.

en: Divide the pitch by the radius: $$\frac{h}{R}=\frac{v\cos\alpha\cdot T}{\frac{mv\sin\alpha}{|q|B}}=2\pi\,\mathrm{ctg}\,60^\circ=\frac{2\pi}{\sqrt{3}}$$

distractors_en.A: the tangent was used instead of the cotangent
distractors_en.C: the angle was not taken into account
distractors_en.D: the factor 2 in the period was dropped

question_en: In a velocity selector the distance between the plates is $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ and a voltage of $600\ \mathrm{V}$ is applied to them; the magnetic induction is $0.15\ \mathrm{T}$ (the fields are perpendicular to each other and to the ion velocity). Find the speed of the ions that pass the selector undeflected ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: Tezlik selektorida plastinkalar orasidagi masofa $2\ \mathrm{cm}$, ularga $600\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanish berilgan; magnit induksiya $0.15\ \mathrm{T}$ (maydonlar o'zaro va ionlar tezligiga tik). Selektordan og'masdan o'tadigan ionlar tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: В селекторе скоростей расстояние между пластинами $2\ \mathrm{cm}$, на них подано напряжение $600\ \mathrm{V}$; магнитная индукция $0.15\ \mathrm{T}$ (поля перпендикулярны друг другу и скорости ионов). Найдите скорость ионов, проходящих селектор без отклонения ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. E = U/d = 600/0,02 = 3·10⁴ V/m; qE = qvB ⇒ v = E/B = 3·10⁴/0,15 = 2·10⁵ m/s.
Asos: tezlik selektori.

en: Field strength and balance of forces: $$E=\frac{U}{d}=3\cdot10^{4}\ \mathrm{V/m},\qquad v=\frac{E}{B}=\frac{3\cdot10^{4}}{0.15}=2\cdot10^{5}\ \mathrm{m/s}$$

distractors_en.D: the distance was left in centimetres

question_en: Singly charged lithium ions with masses $6\ \mathrm{u}$ and $7\ \mathrm{u}$ enter the uniform field of a mass spectrometer perpendicularly with the same speed. The diameter of the semicircle of the light ions is $24\ \mathrm{cm}$. What is the diameter for the heavy ions ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: Massalari $6\ \mathrm{u}$ va $7\ \mathrm{u}$ bo'lgan bir zaryadli litiy ionlari bir xil tezlik bilan mass-spektrometrning bir jinsli maydoniga tik kiradi. Yengil ionlar chizgan yarim aylana diametri $24\ \mathrm{cm}$. Og'ir ionlar uchun diametr qancha ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_ru: Однозарядные ионы лития с массами $6\ \mathrm{u}$ и $7\ \mathrm{u}$ с одинаковой скоростью влетают перпендикулярно в однородное поле масс-спектрометра. Диаметр полуокружности лёгких ионов $24\ \mathrm{cm}$. Каков диаметр для тяжёлых ионов ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. v, q, B bir xil ⇒ R ∼ m: D₂ = 24·7/6 = 28 cm.
Asos: R = mv/(|q|B).

en: The radius (diameter) is proportional to the mass: $$\frac{D_2}{D_1}=\frac{m_2}{m_1}=\frac{7}{6}\ \Rightarrow\ D_2=28\ \mathrm{cm}$$

distractors.C: ionlarning energiyasi bir xil deb olingan (R ∼ √m)
distractors.D: radius massaga bog'liq emas deb olingan
distractors.E: radius massa kvadratiga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что радиус не зависит от массы

distractors_en.C: the ion energies were taken as equal (R ∼ √m)
distractors_en.D: the radius was taken as independent of mass
distractors_en.E: the radius was taken as proportional to the mass squared

question_en: For three substances the relative permeability is $\mu_1=1.00021$, $\mu_2=4000$, $\mu_3=0.99983$. Give the types of the substances in order: $\mathrm{I}$ — diamagnet, $\mathrm{II}$ — paramagnet, $\mathrm{III}$ — ferromagnet.
question_uz: Uchta modda uchun magnit kiruvchanlik: $\mu_1=1.00021$, $\mu_2=4000$, $\mu_3=0.99983$. Moddalarning turlarini tartib bilan ko'rsating: $\mathrm{I}$ — diamagnetik, $\mathrm{II}$ — paramagnetik, $\mathrm{III}$ — ferromagnetik.
question_ru: Для трёх веществ магнитная проницаемость: $\mu_1=1.00021$, $\mu_2=4000$, $\mu_3=0.99983$. Укажите по порядку типы веществ: $\mathrm{I}$ — диамагнетик, $\mathrm{II}$ — парамагнетик, $\mathrm{III}$ — ферромагнетик.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. μ₁ biroz > 1 — paramagnetik, μ₂ ≫ 1 — ferromagnetik, μ₃ biroz < 1 — diamagnetik.
Asos: moddalarning μ bo'yicha turlari.

distractors.B: eng katta μ diamagnetik deb olingan

distractors_en.A: the substances were labelled by their order number
distractors_en.B: the largest μ was taken as a diamagnet
distractors_en.C: substance 1 was taken as ferromagnetic and 2 as paramagnetic
distractors_en.E: the definitions of dia- and paramagnet were swapped

question_en: A current of $8\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a metal plate of width $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ and thickness $0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$. The plate is in a field of induction $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$ perpendicular to its plane. The concentration of free electrons is $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Find the Hall voltage ($\mu\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Eni $2\ \mathrm{cm}$, qalinligi $0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$ li metall plastinkadan $8\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Plastinka tekisligiga tik maydon induksiyasi $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$. Erkin elektronlar konsentratsiyasi $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Xoll kuchlanishini toping ($\mu\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: По металлической пластинке шириной $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ и толщиной $0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$ течёт ток $8\ \mathrm{A}$. Пластинка находится в поле с индукцией $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$, перпендикулярном её плоскости. Концентрация свободных электронов $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Найдите холловское напряжение ($\mu\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. U = IB/(neb) = 8·0,5/(5·10²⁸·1,6·10⁻¹⁹·10⁻⁴) = 5·10⁻⁶ V = 5 μV; b — B bo'ylab qalinlik.
Asos: Xoll effekti.

en: $b$ is the thickness of the plate (along $\vec B$): $$U=\frac{IB}{neb}=\frac{8\cdot0.5}{5\cdot10^{28}\cdot1.6\cdot10^{-19}\cdot10^{-4}}=5\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors_en.A: the induction was left out of the formula
distractors_en.B: the width was used instead of the thickness
